takeaway: Popliteal fossa: superomedial border = semimembranosus and semitendinosus; superolateral = biceps femoris; gastrocnemius heads form the lower borders; floor = femur.

question.text: Which statement regarding the borders of the popliteal fossa is correct?

answer.text: The superomedial border is formed by semimembranosus and semitendinosus.

lines.text: Picture the popliteal fossa as a diamond behind the knee.
The top inner wall, the superomedial border, is semimembranosus and semitendinosus, holding hands.
The top outer wall is the biceps femoris.
Below, the lateral head of gastrocnemius forms the inferolateral border.
And the medial head forms the inferomedial border.
The floor is the popliteal surface of the femur, not the roof. So the answer is B.
